title: Anna Lindgren's roof, from report to signature
sub: This is a sample homeowner in our demo org, not a Cannon customer. Your own QuickMeasure report and Roofr proposal replace it once we have them.

steps.title: Measurements arrive
steps.detail: 28.4 squares at 8/12, 186 lf of eaves and valleys, 212 lf of eaves and rakes, 64 lf of ridge and hip. In the live build the QuickMeasure XML supplies these.
steps.label: Partner build

steps.title: Quote lines build with per-line waste
steps.detail: Shingles 12% plus 2% for a moderate roof is 14%, so 98 bundles. Underlayment 5% plus 2% is 4 rolls. Change any line's waste % and the quantity updates.
steps.label: Configured

shots.caption: Quote line items in the demo org: measured quantity, waste % and order quantity for each material.
shots.label: Demo org

steps.title: The proposal PDF
steps.detail: Logo, scope, line items, total and a signature block. Job photos and sections that change by option need Document Generation or Advanced PDFs.
steps.label: Confirming

shots.caption: Sample proposal PDF saved on the quote in the demo org. It was generated for this preview.
shots.label: Demo org

steps.title: Sent, viewed, signed
steps.detail: The e-signature tool writes each status and time back to the quote, and a Flow can alert the rep when it is viewed. The values shown are simulated.
steps.label: Configured

shots.caption: Proposal status and timestamps on the quote in the demo org. Values are simulated.
shots.label: Demo org

steps.title: The signed quote starts the job
steps.detail: Work order, material list and crew schedule on the same record, then punch list and photos on the crew's phone.
steps.label: Native

shots.caption: The Nov 13 demo journey: from the first call through close-out, signature and payout.
shots.label: Nov 13 demo
